description: Append Accept-Language to Vary without clobbering Next.js RSC tokens (HITL cf-transform). Guest-cache paths stay excluded so the uz-forced homepage is not fragmented.
expression: (http.response.headers["content-type"][0] contains "text/html") and (http.request.uri.path ne "/") and (http.request.uri.path ne "/login") and (http.request.uri.path ne "/register") and (http.request.uri.path ne "/terms") and (http.request.uri.path ne "/privacy")
